articles.headline: Guenther and Sergachev each have goal and assist in Mammoth's 5-4 win over Maple Leafs
articles.description: — Dylan Guenther and Mikhail Sergachev each had a goal and an assist in the second period to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Martin Necas has 2 goals to lead the short-handed Avs past the Stars, 3-2
articles.description: — Martin Necas scored two goals, including a 5-on-3 score, and the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 on Tuesday night in the opener of a home-and-home series.
